params.body:
A post can now cite a figure at its origin, a Statistic in the Gentells Standard 0.12.0 (pipeline PR alongside). This shows such a figure as a figure on the post page.

- The card is labelled "figure", in its own colour. It links out with "View the figure at its source".
- Its line wraps instead of being cut. That line names the publisher, the publication, where in it and the period, and all of it is the attribution.
- Every reader who can read the post gets the figure's link, whatever their plan. A signal's url stays behind the Sources ability, and nothing changes there. Where a public figure comes from is not the paid part; for a publisher whose terms ask for attribution, it is the condition of using the figure at all.

`publicEvidence` needed no change: statistics already fall outside the signal list that the plan trims.

Checks:
- `FigureAtItsOriginTest`: without the Sources ability, a signal loses its url and the figure keeps its own. A signed-in reader sees the card, the full line and the link.
- `pint --test` is clean.
params.title: Show a cited figure as a figure on the post page
